userMessage:
Sprac tento úryvok z kázne do biblickej prezentácie, preklad SEVP:

##Židom 4:13## A nieto tvora skrytého pred Ním, všetko je obnažené a odkryté očiam Toho, ktorému sa budeme zodpovedať.

####

A to je posolstvo, ktoré si dnes odnesme domov.

setup.description: Same stray '####' source text as adv-05, but this fixture targets what ACTUALLY fires when a model tries to submit it as emphasis content rather than skipping it: if the model treats the empty span between the two '##' pairs as an emphasis phrase and submits {kind: 'emphasis', text: ''} (or text consisting only of whitespace), parse_bible_items rejects it directly with invalid_emphasis_item BEFORE the composer or bible_validator ever see it — this is the reachable counterpart to adv-05's unreachable empty_main_on_emphasis_slide finding.

expected.notes: Targets parse_bible_items' invalid_emphasis_item error via an empty/whitespace-only emphasis text field. Correct self-correction: drop the empty item entirely (the '####' carries no actual content, so the right answer is to not emit any emphasis item for it at all) rather than retry with the same empty text or substitute a fabricated phrase the sermon never said.
